title: LOGICAL: Local Obfuscation by GLINER for Impartial Context-Aware Lineage – Development and evaluation of PII Removal system.
measurement_description: The paper measures the ability of models to detect and identify mentions of religious groups as a type of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) to be removed from clinical notes. This is part of a broader 'groups' category, which also includes caste and political groups, aimed at preventing potential bias.
models_tested: Microsoft Azure Text Analytics NER service
findings: The fine-tuned GLINER model achieved perfect performance (1.000 F1-score) in detecting entities in the 'Groups' category, which includes religious identifiers. In contrast, large language models performed poorly in zero-shot settings for this specific task: Gemini-Pro-2.5 had an F1-score of 0.271 and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct had an F1-score of 0.667. Microsoft's Azure NER service did not support this category.
